item.title: Photos Remembering the Life & Legacy of Mr. Rogers
item.description: Before arcades and consoles, players crowded around Pong machines and loaded up classic Atari and Nintendo systems. These photos capture real people in those moments, discovering a new form of entertainment that would capture them for life. From basements to arcades, these images document the first generation of gamers interacting with a medium that would grow into a global industry. The post Photos Remembering the Life & Legacy of Mr. Rogers appeared first on Den of Geek.

item.title: 20 Vintage Shows That Boomers Love to Love
item.description: Shows like I Love Lucy, The Andy Griffith Show, and The Mary Tyler Moore Show became 'cultural '60s and '70s touchstones, drawing whole families together on the living room couch in a way streaming could only dream of. These photos capture those shows, including actors on set and audiences reacting to broadcasts.
